gaps: G1: liveAdmissionAppId differs by call site (message-accept/external-ingress pass a value; seven session routes pass nothing); one boot instance with it baked in silently changes those routes.
G2: toolRepository is getRuntimeToolRepositoryIfReady() evaluated per request on purpose — boot-time construction would latch undefined until restart.
G3: Runtime-store deps (control/ops/repositories/runtimeEvents/skill/mcp) come from mutable globals that tests swap after import; capturing values at boot changes when mocks are observed.
G4: guided-actions-routes.test.ts mocks the createJobManagementService module export, which stops working once routes read ctx.jobManagement.
contradictions: C1: Story demands services be constructed once AND that live values (settings reload, credential broker, tool repo readiness) still read live — construction-time capture cannot satisfy both.
resolutions: G1: Ravi decided 2026-08-03: remove it from the constructor and pass it as a method argument at the one method that uses it; callers keep their current behavior explicitly.
G2: Inject as a getter (() => getRuntimeToolRepositoryIfReady()); the service reads it at use time. Pinned by a before/after-storage-init test.
G3: Same treatment: thin getters over the runtime-store accessors, preserving today's per-use read semantics for both production and tests.
G4: Rework that test to inject a fake via the new ctx seam; called out explicitly in the plan's verification section.
C1: The story itself prescribes the reconciliation: explicit getter injection for every post-boot-mutable dependency; plain values only for boot-stable ones (clock, ids, hashing).
summary: SIMP-2 plan grill: 4 gaps + 1 contradiction, all resolved (liveAdmission method-arg per Ravi; getter injection for every post-boot-mutable dep; guided-actions test reworked to ctx seam).
